attributes.content:
**EL-HAZ-1.5.2 Publish the turn state to infotainment**

GWM_Lighting shall notify TurnlightControlEvent of the SOME/IP service TurnlightIndicator, with LeftTurnlight and RightTurnlight equal to the received LeftTurnLightRequest and RightTurnLightRequest, for every received TurnLightControl frame.

description: Allocated to building block GWM in LightingIndication. The infotainment domain is on SOME/IP and does not see BodyCan0; the GWM is the only path from TurnLightControl to it.
